preconditions.description: The number of silos n must be between 2 and 2000.
The number of scout groups k must be between 1 and n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= ci_j <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
preconditions.description: All passage droid counts ci, j must be between -1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the average danger of the scouting operation, rounded down to an integer.
